title.zh: 将东明多洛省Gloria市镇Maligaya描笼涯的Malamig国立中学附属校分离出来，单独改设为独立的Diosdado Macapagal总统纪念国立中学，并为此拨付所需经费
title.en: An Act Separating the Malamig National High School - Maligaya Annex in Barangay Maligaya, Municipality of Gloria, Province of Oriental Mindoro from the Malamig National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as President Diosdado Macapagal Memorial National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Malamig National High School - Maligaya Annex in Barangay Maligaya, Municipality of Gloria, Province of Oriental Mindoro from the Malamig National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as President Diosdado Macapagal Memorial National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Maligaya của Trường Trung học Malamig Quốc gia tại Barangay Maligaya, Đô thị Gloria, Tỉnh Oriental Mindoro khỏi Trường Trung học Malamig Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Tưởng niệm President Diosdado Macapagal Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Maligaya ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Malamig แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Maligaya เทศบาล Gloria จังหวัด Oriental Mindoro ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Malamig แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอนุสรณ์ President Diosdado Macapagal แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Maligaya, Sekolah Menengah Malamig Nasional di Barangay Maligaya, Kotamadya Gloria, Provinsi Oriental Mindoro dari Sekolah Menengah Malamig Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Memorial President Diosdado Macapagal Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Maligaya, Sekolah Menengah Malamig Kebangsaan di Barangay Maligaya, Perbandaran Gloria, Wilayah Oriental Mindoro daripada Sekolah Menengah Malamig Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Memorial President Diosdado Macapagal Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Malamig National High School - Maligaya Annex in Barangay Maligaya, Municipality of Gloria, Province of Oriental Mindoro is hereby separated from the Malamig National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as President Diosdado Macapagal Memorial National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Malamig National High School - Maligaya Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the President Diosdado Macapagal Memorial National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationaJization of the President Diosdado Macapagal Memorial National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Malamig National High School - Maligaya Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
